company.name: Flagright
company.shortDescription: Flagright delivers AI-native transaction monitoring and AML compliance solutions through its highly customizable, API-first platform.
company.description: Flagright develops an AI-powered platform for anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, transaction monitoring, risk scoring, case management, and regulatory compliance for banks, fintechs, and financial institutions. The company describes its platform as the AI operating system for financial crime compliance and offers AI agents, AI forensics, AI-assisted investigations, and machine-learning-based risk detection capabilities.

productsAndServices.description: AI agents that execute documented AML and financial-crime procedures for screening, monitoring, investigations, governance, and quality assurance with explainable, auditable outputs.
productsAndServices.name: AI Forensics

productsAndServices.description: A real-time and post-event transaction monitoring system for detecting financial crime using configurable, no-code rules, complex aggregations, simulations, and risk-based thresholds.
productsAndServices.name: Transaction Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: A configurable risk-scoring system that combines KYC, transaction behavior, and customer risk factors into continuously updated customer risk assessments.
productsAndServices.name: Dynamic Risk Scoring

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enabled workspace for managing alerts, investigations, escalations, approvals, evidence, quality reviews, and suspicious-activity reporting with configurable workflows and audit trails.
productsAndServices.name: Case Management

productsAndServices.description: Configurable screening for sanctions, politically exposed persons, adverse media, and related risk data across real-time and batch customer or transaction checks.
productsAndServices.name: Watchlist Screening

productsAndServices.description: A regulatory-reporting solution that drafts, reviews, manages, and submits SARs, STRs, CTRs, and other reports across supported jurisdictions and GoAML frameworks.
productsAndServices.name: Regulatory Filing
